title: Nintendo opens up Fire Emblem with the gigantic Fortune’s Weave
summary: Fortune’s Weave ’s structure is a big reason why it feels so open: Instead of locking you to one path, Fortune’s Weave is designed so that you can experience multiple stories in one massive playthrough.
